name: Clipping Distance Computation via Volume Corners
definition: Computes the near and far clipping distances for ray marching by projecting the 8 corners of the volume bounding box onto the camera view direction, then taking the min/max of these projected distances.
summary: Clipping Distance Computation via Volume Corners calculates ray marching bounds by projecting the volume's eight bounding box corners onto the camera view direction to ensure samples stay within spatial limits.
